name: News Heatmap
tagline: World news as a treemap — bigger is more important, brighter is newer
description: A treemap of the news, in the spirit of Newsmap and Newsola. Tile area follows the story's rank and how many outlets are carrying it; hue is the section it came from; vividness fades as the story ages. Arrow keys walk the tiles, Enter or o opens the article. Reads Google News for any of sixteen regional editions, or Gloomberb's own market news feed.
